title: Finite coefficient adjustment for fixed nilpotent ideal generators
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, and let Λ be a commutative local k-algebra with residue field K [def-pc-field-extension]. Let t be a finite subset of Λ whose ideal span is its maximal ideal m, and assume m is nilpotent. Assume H₁(L_{K/k}) is finite dimensional over K [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there exist a ring section σ:K→Λ of the residue map and a finite subset c of K such that every element of the image of k in Λ belongs to the subring generated by t ∪ σ(k(c)). The generators t are fixed inputs; no assertion of algebra generation is part of the conclusion.

source.place: Tag 07FG, proof of the coefficient-field claim, induction on the nilpotence exponent (parent steps 2–7)

proof.text: Generalize the coefficient-field claim to a fixed field K with a compatible surjection r from the local algebra, ker r=m. Prove this generalized claim by induction on an exponent n with m^n=0. At n=0 there is a contradiction since top=bottom in a nontrivial local ring. At n=1, r is bijective, so take its ring-equivalence inverse and c empty. Every i(a) is the section image of its residue, in the image of k(empty).

For exponent n+1 with n positive, set I=m^n, q:Lambda to Lambda/I. I lies in m, so it is proper. Equip the quotient with its induced nontrivial local-ring and k-algebra structures. The map r factors through r prime on the quotient. Its kernel is m.map q, the maximal ideal of the quotient, and it has the same fixed target K and compatible k-structure. The image finset t prime spans the quotient maximal ideal, whose nth power is zero. Apply induction to obtain sigma prime and c prime.

The identity mI=m^(n+1)=0 permits the square-zero coefficient model lifting theorem, which produces sigma,c with the required section and containment. The extra equality of reduced sections is discarded. Apply the generalized induction to K=ResidueField Lambda and the canonical residue map. Compatibility of the algebra maps is the scalar-tower identity.

lean.statement: theorem exists_nilpotent_coefficient_adjustment (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ] (t : Finset Λ) (ht : Ideal.span (t : Set Λ) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ) (hnil : IsNilpotent (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ)) (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hH : Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ) (H1Cotangent k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))) : ∃ (σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ →+* Λ) (c : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)), (IsLocalRing.residue Λ).comp σ = RingHom.id _ ∧ (∀ a : k, algebraMap k Λ a ∈ Subring.closure ((t : Set Λ) ∪ σ '' (IntermediateField.adjoin k (c : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)) : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))))
